messages:
olga: bringing up silverfox-7b (Gemma fork) via qwen loader + int4 path. seeing short-summary hallucinations after quant.
raj: can you repro locally? which quant options?
olga: yes. conversion uses --token-map silverfox.map and --fix-rotary, then per-channel int4 group-size=128. repro prompt: "Summarize refund policy for orders placed before midnight." model invents a clause about "automatic 30-day refund when order id ends in 7".
luis: quick diff vs fp16 gemma baseline: ROUGE-L 0.62 / precision 0.80 -> silverfox int4 0.45 / 0.56. big drop on short factual QA.
ci-bot: CI job 7219: quant-smoke failed (logs https://ci.redwood/7219)
olga: pattern: failures correlate with inputs containing ZWJ or combining diacritics. token splits differ vs original vocab -> kv-cache token offset early in sequence.
raj: token-map file check?
olga: silverfox.map had duplicate mapping for U+200D in one range -> token id shift at boundary. that causes misalignment with rotary phase indices for initial tokens.
amanda: mitigation: normalize and strip ZWJ in loader (unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text).replace('\u200D','')). helps ~70%.
luis: further probe: converter logged a headstride permute; sin/cos tensors may not have been permuted with attention weights. quantizing rotaries to int4 seemed harmful.
raj: experiment: keep rotary sin/cos in fp16 during quant.
olga: result: ROUGE-L -> 0.59 / precision 0.75. large quality improvement with small perf cost.
amanda: running A/B bench for latency vs perf cost now.
ci-bot: bench job 7220 queued.
raj: short-term action: add loader normalization shim + exempt rotary tables in quant pipeline. long-term: conversion must preserve rotary metadata and add unit tests asserting sin/cos permutes.
olga: filed issue #1834 with repro and suggested fixes, added special-char prompt set to CI smoke tests.
amanda: agreed on canary rollout once bench confirms cost tradeoff. thanks team :thumbsup:
